local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local COLORS = {
    bg = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 16),
    surface = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 26),
    disabled = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 44),
    border = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 68),
    accent = Color3.fromRGB(230, 35, 35),
    accentDark = Color3.fromRGB(170, 22, 22),
    accentBright = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70),
    crimson = Color3.fromRGB(110, 15, 15),
    text = Color3.fromRGB(238, 238, 242),
    white = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    black = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
}

local FONT = Enum.Font.GothamBlack

local SRC = [==[
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Children       = 150000
local NestedPerChild = 0
local FieldsPerChild = 0
local FireBurst      = 1
local FrameDelay     = 0.125
local FieldSize      = 0
local RebuildEach    = false

local state = {
    running = false,
    thread  = nil,
    remote  = nil,
    cache   = nil,
    pad     = "",
}

local function resolve()
    local rrs = game:FindFirstChild("RobloxReplicatedStorage")
    if not rrs then return nil end
    local r = rrs:FindFirstChild("SetPlayerBlockList")
    if r and (r:IsA("RemoteEvent") or r:IsA("UnreliableRemoteEvent")) then
        return r
    end
    return nil
end

state.remote = resolve()

pcall(function()
    game:GetService("NetworkClient"):SetOutgoingKBPSLimit(math.huge)
end)

state.pad = FieldSize > 0 and string.rep("P", FieldSize) or ""

local function build()
    local root = table.create(Children)
    for i = 1, Children do
        local entry = { id = i, v = i * 2 }
        for k = 1, FieldsPerChild do
            entry["k" .. k] = (FieldSize > 0) and state.pad or (i + k)
        end
        for j = 1, NestedPerChild do
            entry["n" .. j] = { a = i, b = j }
        end
        root[i] = entry
    end
    return root
end

local function fire()
    if not state.remote then
        state.remote = resolve()
        if not state.remote then return end
    end
    local payload
    if RebuildEach or not state.cache then
        payload = build()
        if not RebuildEach then state.cache = payload end
    else
        payload = state.cache
    end
    for _ = 1, FireBurst do
        state.remote:FireServer(payload)
    end
end

local function start()
    if state.running then return end
    state.running = true
    state.cache = nil
    state.thread = task.spawn(function()
        while state.running do
            pcall(fire)
            if FrameDelay > 0 then
                task.wait(FrameDelay)
            else
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function stop()
    state.running = false
    if state.thread then pcall(task.cancel, state.thread) end
    state.thread = nil
    state.cache = nil
end

return {
    start  = start,
    stop   = stop,
    toggle = function() if state.running then stop() else start() end end,
    isRunning = function() return state.running end,
}
]==]

    active = state

    if state then
        toggle.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.accentBright
        toggleGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(COLORS.accent, COLORS.accentBright)

        toggleGrad.Rotation = 135
        toggleStroke.Color = COLORS.crimson
        toggleLabel.Text = "DISABLED"
        toggleLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
        if api and api.stop then
            pcall(api.stop)
        end
    end
end

toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setActive(not active)
end)

local dragging = false
local dragStart, startPos

main.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = main.Position
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        main.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end)

scripts.features:
Works every game

This script was falsely deleted about 2 months ago but thanks to the owner thunder mods who helped and revived this script.


1: Aimbot (V1)

* Aimbot Toggle: On/Off the aimbot
* Keybind Mode: For pc users
* Show Floating Toggle: A Small ui for Aimbot Toggle which is draggable
* Show FOV Circle: Hide/Show circle
* FOV Circle Size: Circle Size Modifier
* Smoothness Slider: Change How hard it will lock
* Target Priority: Switch between Fov aimbot or distance aimbot (Locks onto nearest player)
* Max Auto-Aim Distance: For Distance Aimbot, modifies the range in studs of nearest player has to be to lock on
* Target Part Selection: Select a specefic part to lock on
* Team Check: Doesnt lock on player in same team
* Wall Check: Checks if player is behind something or not then when player is visible then it locks on
* Enable Specific Team Aim: Searches ur game for all teams then u can select which u teams u want to lock on or not

2: Aimbot V2 (Smart Scan)

* What it does: It Scans ur character and finds Targetable parts, many games customize their character models so use this if normal aimbot doesn't work.
* Aimbot V2 Toggle: Same as V1
* Enable Keybind V2: Same as V1
* Show Floating Toggle: Same as V1
* Show FOV Circle V2: Same as V1
* FOV Circle Size V2: Same as V1
* Smoothness V2: Same as V1
* Target Priority V2: Same as V1
* Max Distance V2: Same as V1
* Team Check V2: Same as V1
* Wall Check V2: Same as V1
* Manual Character Scanner: Scans ur entire character model
* Enable Specific Team Aim V2: Same as V1

3: ESP

* Tracers: Displays Lines on ur screen which shows the players
* Names: Shows players names
* Chams: Highlights players
* Distance (Studs): Check how far is the player
* Team Check: Doesn't esp ur own team members
* Max ESP Range: Range modifier for maximum in which players will be rendered by esp (in studs)
* Use Team Colors: Modifies all esp features by the player team color
* Team Toggles Menu: Similar to Team Specific Aimbot but in esp

4: Hitbox

* Toggle Hitbox: Turn On/Off the Hitbox
* Hitbox Size: Change the size of Hitbox
* Hitbox Transparency: Changes transparency of Hitbox
* Team Check: Does affect ur own teammates Hitbox
* Enable Team Specific: Same As Team Toggle Menu or team specefic aimbot in esp and aimbot Section

5: Configs

* Remove Autoload Config: Remove Config as autoloadr
* Enter Config Name: Modify config name
* Save Config / Overwrite Selected: Overwrite current config with ur currently active features
* Load Config: Load the config (Yeah that's it)
* Set As Autoload: Set ur config autoload, will automatically load ur config after u execute the script.
* Delete Config: Delete ur config
* Config List & Renamer Tool: Modify any Config name.

local function makeDraggable(obj)
	local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
	obj.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = obj.Position
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			obj.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		end
	end)
	obj.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
	end)
end

	local SliderFrame = Instance.new("Frame", Holder)

	local Bar = Instance.new("Frame", SliderFrame)
	Bar.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 4)
	Bar.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.5, -2)
	Bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)

	local Dot = Instance.new("TextButton", Bar)
	Dot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
	Dot.Position = UDim2.new((default-min)/(max-min), -8, 0.5, -8)
	Dot.Text = ""
	Dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	Instance.new("UICorner", Dot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

	local val = default
	local sliding = false
	Dot.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then sliding = true end end)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then sliding = false end end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if sliding and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local per = math.clamp((i.Position.X - Bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / Bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)

			val = math.floor(min + (per * (max-min)))
			Label.Text = name .. ": " .. val

	end)
	return function() return val end

FlyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	flying = not flying
	FlyBtn.Text = flying and "Fly (ON)" or "Fly"
	local char = Player.Character
	if flying and char then
		local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", hrp)
		bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
		local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro", hrp)
		bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)

		task.spawn(function()

				local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
				local dir = Vector3.new(0,0,0)

				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.LookVector end

				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.RightVector end
 -- up & down

                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then dir = dir - Vector3.new(0,1,0) end

	end
end)

-- Dynamic Headless, Korblox, Hair & Accessories Hub
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

	PlayerGui.HeadlessCustomGui:Destroy()
end

local headlessActive = false

local expanded = false

-- Vytvoření GUI

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

local function setHeadless(state)
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char then return end
	local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if head then
		head.Transparency = state and 1 or 0
		local face = head:FindFirstChildOfClass("Decal")
		if face then face.Transparency = state and 1 or 0 end
		head.CastShadow = not state
	end
end

local function setKorblox(state)
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char then return end
	-- Podpora pro R6 i R15
	local rightLeg = char:FindFirstChild("RightLeg") or char:FindFirstChild("RightLowerLeg") or char:FindFirstChild("Right ?")
	local rightFoot = char:FindFirstChild("RightFoot")
	local upperLeg = char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg")

	if state then
		if upperLeg then upperLeg.Transparency = 1 end
		if rightLeg then rightLeg.Transparency = 1 end
		if rightFoot then rightFoot.Transparency = 1 end
		-- Zmenšení / skrytí spodní části pro korblox efekt
		if char:FindFirstChild("RightFoot") then
			char.RightFoot.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		end
	else
		if upperLeg then upperLeg.Transparency = 0 end
		if rightLeg then rightLeg.Transparency = 0 end
		if rightFoot then 
			rightFoot.Transparency = 0 
			rightFoot.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
		end
	end
end

local function setHair(state)
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char then return end
	for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
		if item:IsA("Accessory") and item.AccessoryType == Enum.AccessoryType.Hair then
			local handle = item:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			if handle then handle.Transparency = state and 1 or 0 end
		end
	end
end

local function refreshAccessories()
	for _, child in ipairs(ScrollList:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end
	end

	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char then return end

	local count = 0
	for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
		if item:IsA("Accessory") and item.AccessoryType ~= Enum.AccessoryType.Hair then
			count = count + 1
			local accName = item.Name
			local handle = item:FindFirstChild("Handle")

			local itemFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
			itemFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 42)
			itemFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 36, 48)
			itemFrame.Parent = ScrollList
			local IFC = Instance.new("UICorner") IFC.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) IFC.Parent = itemFrame

			local imgLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
			imgLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 36)
			imgLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3)
			imgLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			imgLabel.Image = "rbxassetid://0"
			imgLabel.Parent = itemFrame
			local ILC = Instance.new("UICorner") ILC.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) ILC.Parent = imgLabel

			task.spawn(function()
				if item:FindFirstChild("AssetId") then
					imgLabel.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(item.AssetId)
				elseif handle and handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") then
					local mesh = handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
					if mesh.TextureId ~= "" then
						imgLabel.Image = mesh.TextureId
					end
				end
			end)
